newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Prices mixed at New Zealand wool sales.
newsitem.headline: Prices mixed at New Zealand wool sales.

text.p: Prices were mixed at wool sales in Dunedin and Napier, Wools of New Zealand said on Thursday.
The provisional market indicator fell four cents to NZ$4.76 with the fine segment up one to $8.92, medium segment down eight to $5.02 and the strong segment down four to $4.34.
Some 18 percent of the 4,182 tonnes on offer was passed in.
Compared with the last sale in Christchurch on September 5, merino fleece varied from 0.5 percent cheaper to 7.5 percent dearer.

Halfbred fleece was 0.5-1.0 percent cheaper, crossbred fleece 0.3-0.5 percent cheaper, second shear was 0-2.5 percent cheaper, bulky skirts were 5.0 percent dearer, second shear was 5-10 percent dearer and crutchings 10 percent dearer.
Main interest came from Western Europe, China, Nepal, local mills, India and Pakistan with support from Australia, Iran and Japan.
The next sale will be a Christchurch on Friday September 20.
